title: API connects to PostgreSQL through a connection pool, sized deliberately per…
description: The API connects to PostgreSQL through a connection pool, sized deliberately per deployment (never left at a framework default without review) — unbounded or misconfigured pooling is a leading cause of production database incidents at scale.
